title: The new gym
instructions: Yeni açılan bir spor salonunun duyurusu. Günleri, saatleri ve fiyatları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Welcome to Body Plus, the new gym on King Street!

script.speaker: voice
script.text: We are open from six in the morning to ten at night, Monday to Friday.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: At the weekend, we open at eight and close at six.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: There is a swimming pool, but it is closed on Mondays.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Yoga classes are on Tuesday and Thursday evenings at seven.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: A month at the gym is thirty pounds. For students, it is only twenty.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: This week, the first visit is free. Come and see us!

questions.prompt: What time does the gym close on weekdays?
questions.feedback: Hafta içi akşam onda (ten at night) kapanıyor. Altı, hafta içi açılış ve hafta sonu kapanış saati.
questions.evidence: from six in the morning to ten at night, Monday to Friday.

questions.prompt: What time does the gym open at the weekend?
questions.feedback: Hafta sonu sekizde (at eight) açılıyor, altıda kapanıyor.
questions.evidence: At the weekend, we open at eight and close at six.

questions.prompt: When is the swimming pool closed?

questions.feedback: Yoga salı ve perşembe akşamları (Tuesday and Thursday evenings) saat yedide.
questions.evidence: Yoga classes are on Tuesday and Thursday evenings at seven.

questions.prompt: How much does a student pay for a month?
questions.feedback: Öğrenciler ayda yirmi pound (only twenty) ödüyor. Otuz normal fiyat; ücretsiz olan yalnızca ilk ziyaret.
questions.evidence: For students, it is only twenty.
